# provenance: GraphQL rate-limit rejection, the shape gh hides behind
# "unknown owner type" for `gh project` commands (#544). The ERROR OBJECT
# {"type":"RATE_LIMIT","code":"graphql_rate_limit","message":"API rate limit
# already exceeded for user ID 12402908."} is verbatim from the live payload
# reported in the #544 task brief (measured by the orchestrator against
# account Zugruul, 2026-11-05, while `gh api rate_limit` still showed quota).
# NOT live-captured here: the surrounding {"errors":[...]} envelope, the
# HTTP/2.0 200 status line and the X-Ratelimit-* headers are RECONSTRUCTED
# (header NAMES and the Reset epoch format are real, copied from
# graphql-items-page-live.txt; remaining is set to 0 as for a rejection).
# Reproducing it for real would exhaust quota shared with running agents.
# source: #544 task brief; graphql-items-page-live.txt for header names.

HTTP/2.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
X-Ratelimit-Limit: 5000
X-Ratelimit-Remaining: 0
X-Ratelimit-Reset: 1793854221
X-Ratelimit-Resource: graphql
X-Ratelimit-Used: 5000

{
 "errors": [
  {
   "type": "RATE_LIMIT",
   "code": "graphql_rate_limit",
   "message": "API rate limit already exceeded for user ID 12402908."
  }
 ]
